name: EduID Age Verification Credential
description: A minimal age-attestation credential derived from an eduID credential presented via OpenID4VP during OpenID4VCI. Carries only age-threshold booleans (13, 15, 18, 21, 65) and validity dates. Assurance level is enforced at issuance time by the presentation scope's required_claims.assurance_level allow-list (see apigw.data_sources.presentation.scopes.eduid_age_verification) and is not carried on the credential itself.

display.label: Age >= 13
display.description: Indicates if the person is 13 years old or older.

display.label: Age >= 15
display.description: Indicates if the person is 15 years old or older.

display.label: Age >= 18
display.description: Indicates if the person is 18 years old or older.

display.label: Age >= 21
display.description: Indicates if the person is 21 years old or older.

display.label: Age >= 65
display.description: Indicates if the person is 65 years old or older.

display.label: Issue Date
display.description: Start date of this credential's validity.

display.label: Expiry Date
display.description: End date of this credential's validity.
